The questions change

You spent decades building it.
Now it needs to support you.

Working toward retirement asks one set of questions. Living on what you’ve built asks another.

Will income cover the life you want? How should your plan respond to a difficult market? What happens to the people who depend on you? Junonia helps you work through those decisions with care, education and the right expertise.

Retirement income planning

You saved for retirement.
Now plan the income.

Moving from accumulation to distribution changes the questions worth asking. We help you see the trade-offs, design an income strategy and connect other expertise when it's needed.

Discuss your retirement income ↗

Why income planning matters

A plan should account for more than an average market year.

Income needs

What do you need each month?

Start with essential spending, lifestyle goals and the sources available to support them.

Timing

What if the market changes early?

Think through the timing of withdrawals and how a difficult period could affect your options.

People

Who else depends on the plan?

Consider spouses, dependents, legacy goals and the people your plan is meant to protect.

Tom's specialty

Income first.
The wider picture always in view.

Tom focuses on understanding income risks and exploring ways different financial tools might work together. Junonia's collaborative approach means additional planning needs can be addressed by appropriate professionals.

Investment, insurance and annuity products differ in features, risks, fees and guarantees. Specific approaches require an individual suitability review.

Meet the coordinating team →

Why Junonia exists

An experience that changed how Tom looks at retirement.

A personal loss of expected income became a reason to help others understand the risks they may face before they retire.

The turning point

He experienced the problem before helping others plan for it.

Tom worked 22 years at AT&T before retiring early to help launch a nonprofit supporting people recovering from addiction. When the dividend income he relied on fell sharply, he experienced how vulnerable retirement can feel when too much depends on one source.

That experience informs the care he brings to retirement-income planning today. It is why he spends time explaining potential risks and exploring ways to avoid relying on one assumption.

A name with meaning

The Junonia shell is rare.
Understanding shouldn't be.

Finding a Junonia shell on Sanibel Island is memorable. The firm's name reflects the kind of moment Tom wants clients to experience: when their financial picture becomes easier to understand and they know where to turn next.

The vision

Built around clients.
Built to outlast any one person.

Together, Tom and Elisa are building a consistent, team-oriented experience with an emphasis on continuity. People should feel cared for by the entire firm, not dependent on one individual's availability.

What happens next

A conversation before a recommendation.

The first conversation is a chance to discuss your goals, your current concerns and whether Junonia's experience may be appropriate for your situation.

Common questions

Can I speak with Tom about my retirement income?

Yes. Retirement-income planning is Tom's main area of focus. Other professionals may participate when a question calls for additional expertise.

Does Junonia offer help outside retirement-income planning?

Junonia works with other professionals on cases involving additional needs. The appropriate professional and services depend on the situation and required qualifications.

Do I need all my documents before we talk?

No. Begin with your questions and goals. The team can explain which information may be useful for later steps.

Can I book directly online?

The approved booking link has not yet been supplied for this design preview. Please use the verified phone number or email once confirmed.

Website privacy

Privacy matters.
So does clarity.

This draft describes the planned handling of information through the Junonia website. It must be reviewed and adapted to match actual website operations before publication.

Draft policy — effective date pending approval. This is review language, not a finalized privacy representation.

Information you choose to provide

If you reach out through a contact link or by email, you may choose to share your name, contact details, questions and other information in that correspondence. Please do not send Social Security numbers, account numbers, medical records or other sensitive personal information through a general website form or ordinary email.

How the current website preview works

The current contact form opens an email draft in the visitor's own email application. The HTML preview does not transmit submitted fields to a Junonia-managed database or provide a live scheduling service. Your email provider handles the transmission if you choose to send it. Production forms, booking tools, CRM integration and data retention practices must be documented when selected.

Why information may be used

Information sent to Junonia may be used to respond to requests, facilitate an initial conversation, coordinate appropriate follow-up, and satisfy applicable business-recordkeeping or legal obligations. Any additional marketing use, mailing lists or newsletter enrollment must be separately reviewed and disclosed.

Service providers and third parties

Depending on the final website configuration, hosting, email, scheduling and related providers may process information needed to deliver their services. This preview loads typography from Google Fonts; visitors' requests for those fonts may transmit technical information to that provider. Links to third-party websites are subject to those sites' own privacy practices.

Cookies and technical information

No custom analytics pixels, behavioral advertising trackers or account-registration features have been configured in this self-contained HTML preview. The production hosting provider may generate server logs or use necessary technical mechanisms to deliver the site. Cookie, analytics and consent disclosures should be updated once those systems are confirmed.

Information security and retention

Online communications cannot be guaranteed entirely secure. Use approved, secure channels for sensitive account or financial documents. Before launch, Junonia should confirm who can access inquiries, how records are secured, and the applicable retention and deletion practices.

Your choices and privacy questions

You can decide what information to include in a message or whether to contact Junonia. Depending on applicable state law, you may have rights to access, correct or request deletion of certain personal information. Contact Junonia using the approved email address or phone number shown on the Contact page to ask how those rights apply.

Children's privacy

The website is intended for adult visitors and is not directed to children under 13.

Changes to this policy

The final policy should display an effective date and describe how material changes are communicated. This draft should not be represented as final until Junonia confirms the website's actual technical operation and obtains appropriate legal review.

For legal review: Confirm the privacy contact method, company entity and address, data processors, state-specific notices, retention periods, analytics and cookie choices, consumer-rights request process, and policy effective date before public launch.

Website information

Website terms of use.

Proposed terms for reviewing the informational website. These terms require review by Junonia’s legal counsel before being adopted.

Draft only — not a published legal agreement. Effective date, operating entity and jurisdiction require confirmation.

General educational content

The website is designed to describe Junonia Financial and the types of conversations its professionals may help facilitate. Nothing on this website is personalized investment, insurance, financial-planning, tax or legal advice, an offer to transact, or a guarantee of future results.

Professional services

Any services, products, affiliations or credentials described are subject to the qualifications, registration and licensing of the individuals involved. The suitability and availability of a product or strategy depend on each person's circumstances and applicable legal requirements.

Website communications

Submitting a question does not create a client relationship. Do not transmit confidential account numbers or sensitive personal financial information using ordinary email or the general inquiry form. Use approved secure communication channels when directed by your professional.

Third-party resources

Links to regulatory organizations and other outside websites are provided as references. Those destinations are maintained by their respective owners and may change. Their inclusion does not imply endorsement of every statement or service found there.

Accuracy and changes

Website information and linked resources may change. Visitors should verify important information with Junonia and review the applicable official service disclosures before making any financial decisions.

Contact

For questions about the website or professional services, please use the Contact page. Questions regarding data handling may be directed through the Privacy Policy contact instructions.

Legal-review checklist: Verify the correct operating entity, jurisdiction, contact address, disclaimer language and whether additional contractual terms are appropriate.
